machine_profile.policy: Prefer one gateway plus cloud/free-tier text models. Do not auto-download large local models.

gateway.credential_policy: Use OmniRoute endpoint tokens or its active context; never commit tokens.

clients.claude: omniroute setup-claude; launch with omniroute launch
clients.codex: omniroute setup-codex; launch with omniroute launch-codex
clients.cursor: omniroute setup-cursor; complete the printed in-app steps
clients.google_ai_studio: Add a Gemini API key through the OmniRoute provider dashboard; never commit it.
clients.antigravity: Connect through normal OAuth only; keep paid credits off; do not enable MITM or stealth.

ollama.model_selection: Discover installed models from /api/tags. Prefer 1.5B-3B quantized models while Studio is open; test memory before using 7B; avoid 9B+ on this machine.

provider_policy.rule: Select only model IDs returned by the live OmniRoute catalog and backed by an authenticated or currently available provider.
provider_policy.deepseek_harness: Not required for routing DeepSeek through OmniRoute; keep separate until the core PM7 stack is stable.
